metric_policy: AP@10 denominator: all known positive judgments; binary grade>0; nDCG gain 2^grade-1; P@5 denominator 5; unjudged results rejected

encoder.quantization: unsigned 8-bit AVX2 export; scores need not equal float PyTorch outputs

semantic.text_policy: title + description + keywords + themes, separated by newlines; tokenizer truncates at 128 tokens

tests_policy: 10 paired two-sided Wilcoxon normal approximations, zero differences removed; Holm family nDCG@10/all queries. Exploratory, not equivalence tests.
uncertainty: 2000 query bootstrap samples, seed 2026; descriptive conditional on this small judgment pool
